title: What Slow to Anger Actually Means for a Godly Man
caption:
Slow to anger doesn't mean he doesn't feel it. It means he's trained the pause between feeling it and doing something with it.

Most anger is guarding something else: fear, shame, getting disrespected in front of people who matter. Name the real thing before you react and it usually drops a notch. Put ten seconds between the spike and the response. Take it to God before you take it to the guy who set you off. That's where you find out if it's righteous or just wounded pride.

Feel it fully. Let it run nothing.

theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
